Paper Name: Solar, Wind, Hydrogen, and Bioenergy-Based Hybrid System for Off-Grid Remote Locations: Techno-Economic and Environmental Analysis
NOTES: System D (PV/BESS/WT/FC/BDG) is the optimal/proposed configuration. Annual load calculated as 11,289 kWh/day x 365 = 4,120,485 kWh/year (daily value from sensitivity analysis section). System D has 0.095% capacity shortage. LPSP not explicitly reported; capacity shortage of 0.095% is the closest reliability metric. COE reported as AUD 0.183 (equivalent to LCOE). Battery: Li-ion, 4 units x 100 kWh = 400 kWh total, usable 320 kWh (min SoC 20%). Electrolyzer efficiency 85%. FC efficiency 60%. Hydrogen tank capacity 1000 kg. BDG fuel B100, price 1.70 AUD/L. Some costs converted from USD at 1 AUD = 0.7 USD. Emission factors not reported in the paper (emissions in kg/year only).
